facts.fact: Hoi 把「箭号」驶离了海港，尽管她完全不会驾船。
facts.anchor: Hoi managed to steer The Arrow away from the harbour.

facts.fact: 从裂口爬出来的东西六条短腿、四只翅膀，身子圆得像猪，没有头也没有脸。
facts.anchor: six stubby legs, four wings and a barrel-shaped body as round as a pig

facts.fact: 她的计划是把整条船变成一张巨符，开进裂口。
facts.anchor: “We, um… turn the ship into a giant fu. Sail it into the rift.”

facts.fact: Hoi 这一回没有挑她计划的毛病，只因为已经没别的路可走。
facts.anchor: He had not picked holes in her plan for once

facts.fact: 她蘸着掺了鸦片的鸡血，把有力量的词句写在主帆上。
facts.anchor: she wrote the words of power on the mainsail

facts.fact: 帆上的字有些写中文，有些写英文，混着来对她已经成为直觉。
facts.anchor: Some of the characters she wrote in Chinese, others in English.

facts.fact: 她生在广州，却在香港才把自己认清楚。
facts.anchor: She had been born in Canton, but Hong Kong was where she had found herself.

facts.fact: Hoi 瘫倒在甲板上，身下渗出一滩深色的血。
facts.anchor: He was slumped on the deck.

facts.fact: Hoi 只说了句「我实在不喜欢那家伙」，就又倒了下去。
facts.anchor: “I really don’t like that guy.” Then he collapsed.

facts.fact: Archie 扑上来之前的一瞬，她就闻出了他的气味。
facts.anchor: Kiamling recognised Archie’s scent an instant before he pounced.

facts.fact: 影兽的脑袋变圆，额上多出一只带火的角。
facts.anchor: a single fiery horn pierced his forehead

facts.fact: 她把盐和米撒在甲板上，双手持剑扑上去。
facts.anchor: Kiamling scattered salt and rice across the decking and leapt forward, sword in two hands.

facts.fact: 银币剑割进影兽的侧腹，它的血溅出来是深蓝色。
facts.anchor: His blood splattered dark blue from the wound as he roared in pain.

facts.fact: Lancaster 在船上催 Archie 动手，要它咬死她。
facts.anchor: “What’s taking you so long? Sic her!”

facts.fact: Archie 迟疑，Lancaster 直接喊「了结她」。
facts.anchor: “Finish it!” Lancaster yelled.

facts.fact: 从天上落下来的那个身影，是祖母。
facts.anchor: Was that… Por Por?

facts.fact: 祖母两只脚踩在一把平放的直剑上，从空中飞过来。
facts.anchor: Her grandmother soared through the air with both feet balanced precariously on the flat of a straight sword.

facts.fact: 剑在 Lancaster 来得及反应之前就扎进了他的侧腰。
facts.anchor: the sword plunging into Lancaster’s side before he had time to react

facts.fact: Jingling 吼着「别碰我姐姐」冲上来，按住了 Lancaster 的穴位。
facts.anchor: “Leave my sister alone!” howled a voice filled with rage.

facts.fact: 他僵住的身体向后倒，翻过栏杆掉进下面翻搅的水里。
facts.anchor: his stiff body toppled backwards and tipped over the railing into the churning waters below

facts.fact: 祖母的符只用老词句，对外来的妖不管用，她被撞在桅杆上昏了过去。
facts.anchor: Por Por had used only the traditional words.

facts.fact: 裂开的镜子照出变形的它自己，它退开，眼睛又闪了一次蓝。
facts.anchor: The cracked glass showed Archie a mutated image of himself.

facts.fact: 帆上她画的符号一笔一笔发白，裂口的边缘开始合拢。
facts.anchor: The symbols Kiamling had painted on the mainsail glowed white, brushstroke by brushstroke.

facts.fact: 合拢忽然停住；符从帆上消失，一只巨人跨过裂口，把主帆扯烂。
facts.anchor: Then it stopped.
